title: DROPZONE: my own take on a minesweeper game
author: Fizassist1
selftext:
DROPZONE is basically my take on turning Minesweeper into an actual 3D game. You parachute into a minefield, read the numbered tiles, and physically walk your way through it without stepping on a mine.

There’s a 10-level campaign, an endless survival mode, and a new Daily Drop where everyone gets the same field and one attempt per day, with verified scores and leaderboards. Survival maps are procedurally generated, and the goal is to get as far from your landing point as you can without blowing yourself up.

It’s fully playable in the browser. Would love to hear what people think!
